reason: Two certified named write-ins need supported display/classification. candidateListComplete false would cause the merger to retain the old complete contests and ignore updates. Therefore both fields remain outside input and every held record is explicitly preserved. Exact current printed blocks and named write-ins stay portable; no fake completeness.
